Snapshot from centuarai-wanx-app-dev-kit commit `5022e6a90c265f198c5dea794fcf16b00f7af430`.

Source: `examples/deployment`. The example JSON files and `cases.json` are vendored unchanged for offline validation.

`js-golden.json` was generated by the source repository's exported `canonicalizeJson`, `computeBundleDigest`, `computeRequestDigest` and `validateDeployment` functions in `tools/deployment/contracts.mjs` at the same commit. It records expected encoded bytes, digests and successful linked outcomes.

`js-invalid-golden.json` records mutations of the source examples and the diagnostic codes returned by the JavaScript validators at that commit. Python tests replay the mutations and verify rejection with an upstream diagnostic code; these expectations were not generated by the Python implementation.

Update schemas, fixtures, Python semantics and cross-language golden tests together. The fixture references are illustrative and do not authorize or execute deployments. Tests use only local snapshots and do not require Node or a sibling checkout.
